sources.title: Shiftry-GX — Sun & Moon Celestial Storm 14/168（Extrasensory）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-07 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: 招式印刷伤害 90+，“If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.”：计算伤害时双方手牌张数相同就追加 90 点（再算弱点抵抗）。

dataContractZh: 数据写法不变：conditional 条件 {"type":"HAND_SIZE","target":"SELF","compare_to":"OPPONENT","comparison":"EQUALS"} 包住 ON_ATTACK 的 damage。
serverAuthorityZh: 原来只有攻击后（AFTER_ATTACK）和训练家的上下文能取对手数量，伤害计算（ON_ATTACK）的上下文没有，数据能通过校验但结算时会出错。现在伤害计算上下文也由服务器提供对手的公开数量。
